title: KEY_GENERATE: inbuf not zeroized on lookup/gate failure
description:
Trigger: on an UNSET fd, write() some bytes (e.g. key material), then call CRYPTO2DEV_IOC_KEY_GENERATE with an algo that either (a) has no registered provider, (b) has a provider that declares no key_generate callback, or (c) has a FIPS provider whose FIPS gate is currently failing.

Bad outcome (FIPS 140-3 CSP zeroization failure): in all three cases the handler reaches 'goto out' without calling inbuf_clear(). The inbuf bytes remain allocated and unzeroized. The fd remains UNSET and the inbuf survives until the fd is closed or another ioctl consumes it.

Specific code paths in ioctl_key_generate (crypto2dev_fd.c):
  - Line 2165-2166: lookup failure (-ENOENT), goto out, no inbuf_clear
  - Line 2173-2175: no key_generate op (-EOPNOTSUPP), goto out, no inbuf_clear
  - Line 2183-2184: FIPS gate rejection, goto out, no inbuf_clear

Contrast: the -EBUSY path (line 2150), key_generate() failure path (line 2196), and success path (line 2201) all call inbuf_clear(). The three missing paths are inconsistent with the stated FIPS 140-3 requirement. DESIGN.md and CLAUDE.md both state 'Key material zeroization is mandatory — use memzero_explicit(). Zero on every exit path — error paths included.'
